title: A scroll position kept by item must follow the item when the rows re-order
rule: When a view keeps its scroll position as an item (a family, a row key) rather than pixels, do not restore it only on mount. An async refetch that lands after the mount (a new sort order, a refresh) can move the item to another row without a scroll event. Watch the item's row index and scroll again when the same item moved, but not when a user scroll picked another item. Add a test that mounts the view, then changes the order through the store, and asserts the item is back at the top.
rationale: E5.3 (#66): leaving a sorted table restored the anchor family at its sorted row; the default order arrived after the mount and a different family ended on top.
